study.question: Observed validation limitation: g0-r0039-context_product remains incumbent at click AUC0.668457307890924 (365.78s,32192421 parameters), above both frozen sources0.660646940486458/0.660163362657485 and DIN0.6555440824200336. Simple compressed-task replacement g0-r0006-compressed_task reached only0.6591942389399411; target-match detail later reached0.6630190236433535. In the recent alternate trajectory, scored block retrieval g0-r0049-block_retrieval_transfer reached0.6683505199248908, raw-content transfer g0-r0051-content_transfer_replay0.6679138863154764, and target-key transfer g0-r0051-target_keys_transfer0.6679875665523606; raw-content blocked replay0.6682888456334517 reverses the corresponding transfer advantage. These negative attempts leave useful retrieval unsupported; their small differences do not refute compression or heterogeneous interests. Candidate source inspection confirms the current product branch sums signed block contributions before its sole tanh history projection. Does moving that projection before occupied-block averaging improve click discrimination at identical learned capacity and justified measured cost, and does the auxiliary adapter-context benefit survive this change?
study.hypothesis: Provisional mechanism, not an observation: aggregate-then-tanh can discard information about heterogeneous signed block contributions sharing the same sum. Let b_j be the existing target-scored, count-weighted block contribution, M the number of occupied uniform-history blocks, and r the unchanged global counts/five detail summaries. Compare local s=(1/M)sum_occupied tanh(W_h[M*b_j,r]) with aggregate s=tanh(W_h[sum b_j,r]), followed by the same context product/RMS/output. Before tanh their occupied mean agrees exactly in real arithmetic. Local summaries can discriminate histories of equal aggregate but different block distributions, without softmax selection, added matrices or changes to the original base/moment readout. It may also damage useful intensity through saturation; usefulness is falsifiable. Auxiliary feedback uses the same uniform occupancy definition, even when its feedback block contribution is zero.

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary lines250-282: DIN motivates target-aware local activation, explicit product interactions and unnormalized interest intensity. Inherit signed target scoring; the proposed change is the order of a tied task-history tanh projection and averaging over already-compressed blocks, while preserving the original unnormalized base. This is an adaptation, not original DIN reproduction or a priority claim.

Pinned primary benchmark source lines215-274 constructs fixed/feature-conditioned queries and distinct key/value/output projections before attention. Here no new query bank, key/value matrices, attention or partition schedule is added: one inherited history matrix is applied to each fixed compressed block with global details. Original HeMix full-paper equivalence/novelty unverified.

Pinned primary source lines221-301 alternates sequence self-attention/FFN encoding, global-query decoding and boosting. Per-token nonlinear transformation before global summaries is established practice; here only the placement of one inherited tanh over frozen block values changes, without sequence evolution, depth or new weights.

Resolved local receipt and inspected r0051 standalone descendant: the prior retrieval branch reweighted signed base contributions before one global projection. The present branch averages tied nonlinear block projections, keeps original base/moments and has no context softmax or target-conditioned keys. Both are local variants, not independent prior-art claims.

study.proposed_difference: Add architecture-only summary_placement=block|aggregate. Return the existing per-block signed contributions alongside the same reductions. Build local inputs [M*b_j,r] only from valid occupied blocks, with invalid b_j zeroed before projection and masked after tanh; average in FP32 with denominator max(M,1). Apply the same existing nn.Linear to [B,10,H] and [B,H]. Select local or original aggregate output and add zero times the unused result so both eager backward graphs execute. Preserve global base, global counts/five detail paths, product/RMS and outer has_history gate. Cross placement with the broad auxiliary adapter-context gate; this gate affects the inherited residual branch too, so the factorial estimates architecture-by-broad-transfer interaction, not isolation of the product gradient alone. No new trainable/nontrainable state. New model performance unmeasured; closest-work originality unverified.
predictions: At common nonzero interaction output weights, unequal block distributions with the same total can produce different local summaries, while the aggregate control is invariant when all global details are held fixed. Exact same-sum discrimination is an algebraic capacity property, not evidence that these distinctions predict labels.

M=1 or identical normalized block contributions should recover the aggregate summary in exact arithmetic; replacing tanh by identity should make local and aggregate agree for all nonempty supports. Empty local summary is finite zero and the original outer has_history gate removes history corrections.

Local transfer click AUC should exceed aggregate transfer and the incumbent0.668457307890924 at measured cost; frozen-source and DIN comparisons remain anchors. If successful, expected benefit from histories with multiple occupied blocks is exploratory, not a confirmatory slice test.

The placement-by-gradient interaction is [(block_transfer-aggregate_transfer)-(block_blocked-aggregate_blocked)] on full-validation click AUC. Its sign is not assumed from r0050/r0051; broad transfer may help, hurt or leave the new branch unchanged.

All four cells should retain exactly32192421 total /31793216 embedding /399205 dense parameters and identical state shapes/order; aggregate bridges should be numerically consistent with their r0039 parents before any performance interpretation. Extra dense projection work must appear in measured time/memory rather than be called free.

Predeclared bridge comparison tolerances before host training: at common weights and inputs use FP32 probability atol1e-6/rtol1e-5 and gradient atol1e-7/rtol1e-4; BF16 probability atol1e-4/rtol1e-2 and gradient atol1e-5/rtol5e-2 as initial numerical acceptance thresholds. Scorer/tower Dice buffers and inherited RNG should agree exactly where operations are unchanged. Record maximum discrepancies and representative tensors; exceeding a threshold triggers diagnosis, not automatic tolerance expansion or a scientific conclusion. Long-run receipt replay is an observation to measure, not guaranteed by one-step tolerances.
falsifiers: Failure to exceed matched aggregate control and incumbent at acceptable measured cost leaves useful nonlinear-before-aggregation unsupported for this implementation; exceeding weaker frozen sources alone is insufficient.

A same-total/different-dispersion pair cannot change the local nonzero-weight summary, or invalid-slot changes affect it: implementation does not implement the hypothesized operation. Homogeneous, singleton, permutation or linear-limit identities failing beyond native tolerances block training until diagnosed.

If aggregate bridges fail common-weight predictions/gradients/Dice-buffer/one-step parity with incumbent or blocked parent beyond declared FP32/BF16 tolerances, investigate execution/roundoff/ownership rather than attribute an AUC difference to nonlinear order.

A gain explained by saturation/scale or coarse length effects without useful grouping specificity would not establish preservation of heterogeneous predictive interests. A follow-up interleaved-group or norm/linear-matched replacement is required before such a mechanism claim.
Auxiliary item/action/scorer/target gradients, changed labels/information boundary, additional unaccounted parameters or a resource cap violation invalidate comparison regardless of AUC.

Any single-seed advantage remains preliminary; repeated-seed or user-cluster uncertainty that removes/reverses the advantage weakens useful complementarity. Withheld feedback never selects or revises this proposal.

Before-pooling tanh changes saturation, latent scale, optimization and sensitivity to dispersion together; a gain alone does not prove recovery of useful heterogeneous interests
M scaling preserves the preactivation average in exact real arithmetic; BF16 arithmetic, reduction order, feedback sparsity and history occupancy still influence the contrast

Observed retrieval failures may concern query quality/value scaling or insufficient optimization, not the aggregate bottleneck. This is a distinct discriminating implementation, not a refutation of retrieval.

Local averaging reduces magnitude and changes effective regularization; M*block scaling can accentuate saturation for long histories. RMS after product does not remove directional or optimization confounding.
Auxiliary labels are offline user/category/brand24h matches, not ad-specific causal conversion outcomes; benchmark field/vocabulary/prefix visibility may not transfer to production.
